title: Clinical author and correction integrity
acceptance_scenarios: Attempt author/order relinking, content change and deletion/cascade through UI and APIs. Demonstrate original preservation, addendum export and offline identity attribution.
evidence_after_implementation: A02-note-addendum-exhibit.pdf; A02-mutation-results.json; original-and-addendum.json; SHA-256 manifest. Use synthetic clinical records.
manual_acceptance: Clinical reviewer approves late-entry/correction policy; security reviewer checks privileged access boundaries. Refresh after authoring, sync or schema changes.
history_policy: Do not invent legacy consent times, rewrite existing clinical seals, or record mock authority responses as real acceptance.
implemented_controls: Authenticated finalization issues a v2 clinical seal over care time, correction reason, identity, audio and coding sidecars. RPC-created signatures and client-context bypasses are refused. Author/order/content lock after finalization; corrections use addenda. Existing v1 verification remains unchanged.
remaining_actions: Approve clinician identity and supervisor permissions. Legacy missing event times remain missing.
